steps.do: Before freezing, tell the customer what a freeze does. All new transactions will be declined, and so will recurring payments and subscriptions. Pending transactions that were already authorized may still process. They can unfreeze at any time through customer service or the mobile app. A freeze does not block ATM use by someone who has the PIN; ATM Block must be turned on separately in the mobile app.
